data.title: Sun City
data.about:
Sun City is the latest master community by DAMAC Properties, strategically situated in the vibrant area of Cherrywood, Dubailand. Each of our 4- and 5-bedroom townhouses is thoughtfully designed to bring the outdoors in, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the home with natural light. Every space seamlessly integrates with the lush surroundings of the community, and the exterior design showcases a peaceful lifestyle, combining sleek lines with natural, organic elements.

At the center of Damac Sun City at Dubailand is a stunning tribute to the life-giving power of water, serving as an impressive focal point that embodies holistic wellness. Sun City combines the tranquility of suburbs with the convenience of city life, making it a sought-after location for those looking to invest in a serene yet accessible family home.

characteristics_module.title: Embar on a Wellness Journey Amidst Nature!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Wellness-Focused Living: Sun City offers a holistic wellness retreat, where each day begins with natural light and ends with beautiful sunsets, designed to nurture both mind and body.
  • Prime Location in Dubailand: Located in the heart of Dubailand, Sun City provides easy access to key highways, nearby attractions, and major international airports, making it minutes away from everything.
  • Exclusive Community and Amenities: Sun City offers a wide range of luxurious amenities, including outdoor yoga, hiking trails, tennis courts, and a grand water fountain, creating an environment that blends luxury with nature.
  • Seamless Indoor-Outdoor Experience: Designed with floor-to-ceiling windows and lush surroundings, every home in Sun City brings the outdoors in, offering residents a peaceful and serene living environment.

location_tile.title: Dubailand – Steps from All You Need
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
As a residential haven, Dubailand boasts a plethora of housing options. It is the ideal destination for those looking to reconnect with nature and find refuge from the nearby city’s hustle and bustle. This beautiful community offers convenient access to major roads and highways and is located close to Al Maktoum International Airport.

The community is meticulously planned to include schools, healthcare facilities, and retail centers, ensuring that every need is within reach. With its blend of leisure, entertainment, and residential options, Dubailand is not just a place to live but a place to thrive, making it an ideal choice for those looking to put down roots in a vibrant and growing area of Dubai.

more_info.answer: Residents of Sun City can enjoy a variety of amenities designed to enhance their lifestyle. The community includes features such as landscaped gardens, children’s play areas, community swimming pools, and dedicated fitness centers. Additionally, the development is designed with pedestrian-friendly pathways and community centers that foster a vibrant community spirit.
more_info.question: What amenities are available within Sun City for residents?

more_info.answer: Sun City is strategically located in Dubailand, providing excellent connectivity to the rest of Dubai via major highways. It is a short drive from Dubai’s downtown area and other key urban hubs.
